title.narrative: Food basket in the Republic of Benin for the year 2025

description.narrative: To enhance and increase food security for the needy and destitute families, and to help heads of needy households bear the costs of food for their families and relatives.

To enhance and increase food security for the needy and families suffering from extreme poverty in the Republic of Benin . The project will meet the needs of the most vulnerable families in several villages in the Republic of Benin by providing and distributing food baskets, which will contribute to alleviating suffering and bringing joy to the most needy and destitute families in the Republic of Benin. (5,650) food baskets will be distributed, with a total number of beneficiaries reaching 34,582.
To provide assistance to the most needy, affected, and destitute families through the provision and distribution of food baskets
